product_metadata.title: Monkkino Lemon Squeezer, Lemon Squeezer Juicer, Citrus Juicer Handheld, Lemon Juicer, Stainless Steel Juicer Hand Press, Lime Squeezer Bar Tool, Manual Citrus Press, Lime Juicer with Zester, 2 pcs
features: 🍋【GET ALL JUICE FROM YOUR FRUIT】Monkkino lemon squeezer juicer is proven to get 30% more juice output than radiational juicers. The one-piece press head makes juice extraction easier to use, not easy to break, and the squeezing tooth pattern is more efficient. The multi-directional juice hole design at the bottom with a 2.76-inch diameter round bowl ensures to hold larger lemons and the juice is completely squeezed out.

🍋【High Quality Material & Scientific Design】Monkkino citrus juicer is made of 304 high-quality stainless steel and polishing process, durable, corrosion-resistant, and color-fast, doesn’t react with fruits, nor does it breed bacteria. Never worry about the health and original flavor of the juice. With an ergonomic handle, it is comfortable to hold.

🍋【Easy to Use & Clean】This Lime squeezer adopts a humanized appearance: portable and effortless. Smooth lines prevent hand pain. Simple operation: open the clip, take out half of the lemon peel and press upwards, squeeze fresh juice in one second. Also, very easy to clean, just rinse with clean water, eliminating the cumbersome cleaning problems of traditional juicers. Process and also power-saving, health, and environmental protection.

🍋【Widely used & Multi-Function】With a big size bowl to hold and squeeze all kinds of fruits：lemon, orange, lime, citrus, easily juice the original flavor, enjoy high-quality nutrition life. And it is suitable for all you need: pair with meat, mixed with vegetables, bartending, direct drinking or cooking.

🍋【Perfect Squeezer Combo with Lemon Zester】Along with the brilliant build quality, this combo comes with a lemon zester which is also made up of heavy-duty material. You can easily use this zester to peel, scraping and many other purposes to make cooking an exciting thing. If you are not satisfied with our manual citrus squeezer, 24-hour online after-sales service to solve any questions for you.
